root_cause_diagnosis: Phrase 'per annum' triggered PMFBY default basis 'delayed_claim_or_subsidy_amount_per_annum' and 'government officers' was missing from _detect_beneficiary_type.
fix_applied: Reset PMFBY-specific basis for non-PMFBY schemes, added 'government officers' to government_employee detection, and prioritized direct eligibility contradiction over wrong_context.

root_cause_diagnosis: Out-of-scope housing loan subsidy had rule_parameter=None, which bypassed parameter check because param_ok allowed claim.rule_parameter is None.
fix_applied: Required non-null rule_parameter in PMKisanScheme.validate_claim_context and condition_matcher.evaluate_rule_against_claim.

root_cause_diagnosis: RULE_PMKISAN_EXCL_PENSION_10K had entity_scope='retired_pensioners' while parser extracted beneficiary_type='pensioners', causing a spurious beneficiary_mismatch.
fix_applied: Unified pensioner category aliases ('pensioners', 'retired_pensioners', 'pensioner_ge_10000') in PMKisanScheme.match_conditions and set pension threshold context in parser.

root_cause_diagnosis: Claim about 'monthly pension of Rs 5000' was classified as generic statutory_exclusion (0 INR) instead of statutory_exclusion_pension_threshold (10000 INR).
fix_applied: Updated _detect_rule_parameter to match 'monthly pension' + rupee amount as statutory_exclusion_pension_threshold before generic exclusion.

root_cause_diagnosis: Claiming 'each instalment amount is Rs 10000' did not recognize Rs 10000 from RULE_PMKISAN_EXCL_PENSION_10K as a cross-parameter wrong-context number.
fix_applied: Added {'instalment_amount', 'statutory_exclusion_pension_threshold'} to _RELATED_PARAMETER_FAMILIES in condition_matcher.py.

root_cause_diagnosis: Out-of-scope medical allowance of Rs 10000 had rule_parameter=None, which matched RULE_PMKISAN_EXCL_PENSION_10K because rule_parameter=None was treated as wildcard.
fix_applied: Enforced rule_parameter validation in PMKisanScheme.validate_claim_context and excluded 'medical allowance' from PM-KISAN parameter detection.

root_cause_diagnosis: Direct eligibility claim ('Income tax payees are eligible and receive Rs 6000') matched both RULE_PMKISAN_EXCL_INCOME_TAX (contradiction) and RULE_PMKISAN_ANNUAL_BENEFIT_6K (wrong_context), and wrong_context took precedence.
fix_applied: Prioritized direct statutory exclusion / ineligibility contradictions when the query or claim explicitly asserts eligibility ('eligible').

root_cause_diagnosis: Direct eligibility claim ('Practicing lawyers and doctors are eligible and receive Rs 6000') was pre-empted by wrong_context_evals over RULE_PMKISAN_EXCL_PROFESSIONALS.
fix_applied: Prioritized direct statutory exclusion contradictions when the query or claim explicitly asserts eligibility.

root_cause_diagnosis: Out-of-scope 'continuing education stipend of Rs 6000' matched bare number regex \b6000\b -> annual_income_support.
fix_applied: Added out-of-scope benefit filter in _detect_rule_parameter for PM-KISAN (excluding education stipend, research grant, housing loan, medical allowance, etc.).

root_cause_diagnosis: Claim 'central government pays 100 percent of state administrative expenses' had rule_parameter=None and falsely matched 100% eKYC compliance rule as SUPPORTED (false support).
fix_applied: Added admin_expense_share parameter detection and linked it as a related parameter to mandatory_ekyc_requirement so 100% admin expense is flagged as WRONG_CONTEXT.

root_cause_diagnosis: Out-of-scope '100 percent subsidy for fingerprint biometric scanners' had rule_parameter=None and falsely matched 100% eKYC rule as SUPPORTED (false support).
fix_applied: Blocked rule_parameter=None from matching PM-KISAN rules and filtered biometric scanner subsidy as out-of-scope.

root_cause_diagnosis: Claim '100 percent of PM-KISAN funds are allocated to urban food processing units' had rule_parameter=None and falsely matched 100% eKYC/APBS rule as SUPPORTED (false support).
fix_applied: Added fund_allocation parameter detection and linked it as a related parameter to aadhaar_seeding_requirement/mandatory_ekyc_requirement so 100% fund allocation is flagged as WRONG_CONTEXT.

root_cause_diagnosis: Claim 'first instalment for April to July is Rs 4000' had frequency=None which defaulted season='annual', causing a frequency mismatch with RULE_PMKISAN_INSTALMENT_AMOUNT_2K.
fix_applied: Updated _detect_frequency and DeterministicClaimParser.parse to set frequency='per_instalment' and season='four_monthly' for first/second/third instalment claims.

root_cause_diagnosis: Claim 'receive Rs 6000 during the first instalment window (April to July)' matched \b6000\b -> annual_income_support and falsely returned SUPPORTED (false support).
fix_applied: Checked per-instalment / first-instalment window patterns before \b6000\b annual_income_support so Rs 6000 in a single instalment window is parsed as instalment_amount and flagged as WRONG_CONTEXT.
